facts.claim: All 210 unfiltered calls and numerical, JIT, counter, lifetime, graph and cleanup gates validate; both actual controls selected the same RQ FL3 KS7 kernel.
Fresh pack + split4 main + FP32 reduce median 40.288us loses selected PW36/RS32 by 22.848/23.184us paired, with 0 of 30 wins against each.
Candidate 144 CTAs and 122 registers did not imply full-pipeline speed over the selected RQ with 126 CTAs.

Frozen-source logical X payload is 72MiB for the candidate versus 36MiB for the selected control. Pack adds 2MiB read + 2MiB write; partials add 4.5MiB write + 4.5MiB reduce read. These are not measured DRAM bytes or time.

Driver wall time was 144.900s; source-bound candidate JIT phase 43.989s and real weights plus full prepares phase 98.999s. This observation is environment/cache-specific, not a universal timeout bound.

hypotheses.claim: Increased global X delivery/front-end demand or decoded-B publication may dominate despite higher CTA coverage.
Fresh pack, FP32 partials and reduction may contribute to the regression; their share is unknown because only node names were archived.

not_established: performance of the entire reverse family

discriminating_next_test.action: Only if information ROI warrants, run one bounded frozen full-pipeline diagnostic with the actual selected RQ and candidate pack/main/reduce. Quantify auxiliary-node contribution and source-bound main X-request versus B-publication exposure.
discriminating_next_test.supports: Auxiliary cost near the observed gap supports a fusion focus. Small auxiliary cost with a slow main rejects an auxiliary-only explanation. Source-mapped requests and stalls can distinguish X-delivery from B-publication hypotheses.
controls: actual selected policy and full pipeline
discriminating_next_test.limits: No PC fraction to time or DRAM inference; no automatic rerun or GPU authorization. A changed version is required for the next optimization.

retention: Keep this exact valid regression as a control; one version loss is not a family ban. No integration or promotion.
